verdict.rationale: Puzzle is an accounting product, so AP aging and vendor balances are a fair axis to judge. The evidence pack never mentions an accounts payable aging report, vendor balances, or point-in-time AP views. It only documents general real-time financial reports, GL and financial statement exports, and cash/accrual bases, which are adjacent features rather than this capability.

support.subject: As an accountant, I can see accounts payable aging and vendor balances at any point in time
